scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix backend run db:clean && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.portable: npm run install:all && npm run db:init && npm run build
scripts.db:init: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
